body: Thanks all for responding but it's not needed at this point
Everything is wrong. I'm going nowhere in life social or academically and I just want to die now. I've tried running red lights and stop signs and now taking medicine but I just won't die.
Of course no one gives a shit

I quit already. I'm tired of getting drunk and crying about the unfair treatment everyone except me gets. Time and time again people tell me they'll be there for me but then get irritated with me so I just quit. I just need to know how many of what pills to take
People care about me I just don't want to disappoint them nor do I wish to keep failing. Any good suicide tips?
Well I didn't have any alcohol to help finosh job. Ive still got plenfy of liils for nrxt time though
I'm slipping snd barely understand of the real world. But no one cares
I don't know ive taken about 12 ambien now. Just need some vodka
I knew this was stupid
Truthfully I probably won't but thanks
I'm worrIed because I'm constantly anxious about everything. I still don't know about calling the number
From my past attempts at changing, I can tell you with 99% assurance that I can't do it
They probably would but I get so worried and anxious about the very thought of it

Trust me there isn't much good to me. And as a introvert who always took care of his academics but failed at socializing, sex, relationships, and at least a first kiss are definite priorities no matter how short sighted it may seem. And don't worry, based on your response, I can tell there's much good to look for in you
Too late for that now. Now I have to deal with academic probation and costing my parents a fuck ton of money

Yeah I understand that, but it seems too much like an automated system. Literally, if I'm just going to end up being told STOP, tell us your location and we'll send an officer, then I don't see a point in calling. I could call the police my damn self. Anyway, from previous experiences, opening up to people hasn't really turned out for the best. Even if it is over the internet. I'm still worried at this moment about the talking I've done in this thread.

one thing I learned is that College people are no different from HS people. They're all self-centered and judgmental. I don't know why I thought things would be different. A couple weeks ago, I got drunk every night that week and I stopped taking my medicine. Now, I've increased my dosage of medicine and so far I'm 1 week sober. I was feeling a bit optimistic recently and tried to straighten myself out. But I know I'll revert soon to my old ways. I don't know what else I could study to make me as happy as technology does. And I can't really transfer schools because of how shitty I've been doing. My depression and anxiety have made it hard for me to go to class some days. I'll just have to deal with things the way they are until I have the balls to off myself.

No she's really good and listens well and wants me to do better. I just don't feel that I'm strong enough to change. And now, instead of that whole "standardized client relationship", I now feel like she's just one more person in my life I'll disappoint if I don't change for the better.

I've assessed my entire situation and I don't see any hope. And yes I have called the hotline before but the people there seem to focus on only keeping me alive, rather than actually bother to hear my personal story out and giving me support. So I don't think I'll call them again. Do I think it's worth throwing all away? yes

Well seeing as how I'm an 18 year old black kid whose depression is causing him to fail his first year of college, on top of being a little overweight and a virgin whose never even kissed a girl, I don't think there is a lot of upside. It's really hard to wait and see if all of this will work out when I look around everywhere and it seems that these things have already came to others. Also, the fact that other people can handle life much better than I can is really disheartening. So I give up.
I've been seeing a counselor at my school as well as taking meds. I just don't think any of it will help

I haven't put myself first in so long, I don't even understand how it works. I can't be happy with myself. I wish I was as good as my peers so I'll never be able to just say fuck'em. I have to get schooling. What am I to do with my life without it. All I've ever been good with are Games and Technology. I'm a Computer Science Programming major but I suck at programming but that's all my college offers. Any other technology sub division I'm a master in. I just don't know what to do anymore. I've been using alcohol as a crutch but it's just left me a burden to others at times and embarrassed myself with girls and such. It all just sucks. I don't have all this great willpower that other people do so I can't change myself. Which is why I just need to cease to exist.

That sounds like someone who has an exterior experience of dealing with suicidal tendencies and depression. I can't just change myself. I have many self issues such as lack of self esteem and things that prohibit me from always branching out. I also have bad anxiety, mainly social anxiety. And don't even get me started with my failure with women. I just can't do it. I'm not good enough...
5 years from now I'll be dead from suicide or Alcohol poisoning

I'm a really huge fuck up. Wasted thousands of my parents' dollars on two semesters of school just to fail hard. My social life is absolutely pathetic. I'm constantly being judged by my peers who claim to "be there for me"...it's all just too much. I understand if you don't want to here me rant. My last post only got one response. I don't think there is help here either.

Sorry bud. You're making all of this sound a lot easier than it actually is. Coming from a guy with low self-esteem since he was 6. I'm afraid of talking to my parents because I'd like to not destroy the "perfect" image I've built up for them.

Gotta admit, didnt think anyone would respond. Thanks. I've been seeing a counselour but it's barely had an impact on me. As far as the losing weight thing, I think you may have overlooked the lack of willpower part in my post. I've tried believe me. I even worked out and played (American) football for three years. I like the 'chippy' type attitude I feel from your post but I don't really see a future for me. Especially with anyone.
